randombytes
===

[![Version](http://example.invalid/npm/v/randombytes.svg)](https://example.invalid/package/randombytes) [![Build Status](https://example.invalid/crypto-browserify/randombytes.svg?branch=master)](https://example.invalid/crypto-browserify/randombytes)

randombytes from node that works in the browser.  In node you just get crypto.randomBytes, but in the browser it uses .crypto/msCrypto.getRandomValues

```js
var randomBytes = require('randombytes');
randomBytes(16);//get 16 random bytes
randomBytes(16, function (err, resp) {
  // resp is 16 random bytes
});
```
